actions.title: Actions
actions.tag: Windows asks for administrator approval when an action changes this PC.
action.needsAdmin: Windows asks for administrator approval when you confirm.
action.needsOnline: This action downloads from the pinned sources; it needs an internet connection.
action.install.title: Install
action.install.changes: Reinstalls the gateway in place, or rebuilds it from scratch when Clean install is selected.
action.install.cleanHint: Delete the existing install directory and rebuild it from the pinned sources.
action.update.title: Update
action.update.changes: Checks the approved manifest and updates the engine, its services, and the watchdog to the approved versions.
action.pause.title: Pause
action.pause.changes: Stops the gateway's services and resets this PC's DNS to DHCP. Nothing is removed; Resume puts it back.
action.resume.title: Resume
action.resume.changes: Starts the gateway's services again and re-applies its DNS settings to every adapter.
action.restart.title: Restart
action.restart.changes: Restarts both gateway services without changing the configuration.
action.upstream.title: Set upstream
action.upstream.changes: Changes the DNS-over-HTTPS upstream the gateway forwards to, then restarts the services.
action.dns.title: Set DNS servers
action.dns.changes: Sets these DNS servers on every adapter (IPv4 and IPv6, rolled back on failure). The gateway's services keep running.
action.language.title: Set engine language
action.language.changes: Sets the language the engine prints in its console and transcripts. The manager's own language is separate.
action.cdn.title: Test CDN optimization
action.cdn.changes: Runs a read-only CDN check and reports the result. Nothing on this PC changes.
action.uninstall.title: Uninstall
action.uninstall.changes: Stops and removes the services, the watchdog task, the DNS settings, and the install directory.
